description: walk-stop — authored through the bareloop panel (green, js)

jobLines.text: Fix any failing test on chore/barebrowse-031 branch: chore/barebrowse-031

goal: Fix any failing test on the chore/barebrowse-031 branch while keeping every existing test.

notes: The repository suite is RED at seed (# fail 1, one `not ok` line) — that is precisely the failing test line 1 asks to be fixed, so both suite stages are intentionally red until the work is done.

`tests-executed-not-dropped` is green at seed by design: it is a floor enforcing the person's ~rule 'keep every existing test' — it can only go red if a run deletes, skips or deselects tests. Counted from the TAP `# tests N` summary (executed count, not passes), baseline measured at seed.

The TAP summary lines carry no file path, so the seed-read emits an advisory that the scope filter could not judge them. This is not an instrument stop; the population is named by the stage (scoped to tests/), and the figure is read from the runner's own summary.

`npm test` is two gates joined by &&: the hermetic suite and scripts/prompt-commit-check.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD. The facts object warns that in a detached worktree with no origin/main that second range resolves to zero commits and passes vacuously — so the exit-code stage cannot prove the commit-message gate ran. I did not add a separate stage for it, because the person's job line says nothing about commit messages.

Fixture and world files under tests/ are also in scope for the write fence per the person's Destination answer, so a fix that edits a fixture rather than the code under test is permitted by this close; only `tests/` was selectable.

The genre template calls for a strict-typecheck stage only when strictness was asked for; the person asked to fix a failing test, so no typecheck stage is composed. Note that tsconfig includes only src/**/*.js anyway, so tests/ is not type-checked by the repo's own checker.
Ignored per the interview's ~rule handling: 'keep every existing test' is a rule, expressed here as the executed-count floor, and is not listed in refused.
